text:
maria: Heads-up — after kernel v3 rolled to prod we started seeing short-request tail latency spikes. Looks like long sequences are holding slots and short lanes pile up.

vikram: Can you paste the perf numbers? p50/p95/p99 and queue lengths pls.

maria: Quick snapshot from the trace (10:23):
```
p50: 18ms  p95: 120ms  p99: 980ms
short-queue-length: 42  long-queue-length: 3
kernel-selection: KERNEL_FASTPATH preferred for seq_len>1024
```

chen: Hmm. Kernel v3 changed the cost heuristic — it prefers the fastpath kernel once seq_len crosses 1024 because it estimated lower per-token cost, but it also disables slice preemption. Net effect: long requests keep GPU slices longer.

luca: That matches the telemetry I saw — KV hit-rate for short tenants dropped ~10%, which forces extra decoding and increases latency. Could be kv warmup/eviction interaction.

anya: Are these tenant-local effects or global? i.e., is one noisy tenant causing starvation?

bench-bot: telemetry summary for last 30m: 
- tenants affected: 18
- median kv_hit_rate delta: -0.12
- short-path p99 increase: +420ms
(rolling window, sample=12k requests)

vikram: Root cause hypothesis: kernel-selection decision now biases toward long-fastpath and disables micro-preemption. Need either: (A) allow preempt on fastpath, or (B) add a short-preferring admission reserve.

maria: I sketched a quick config we could canary: add a "short_slot_reserve" and a per-tenant token budget target for long sequences. Example: 
```
batcher:
  short_slot_reserve: 0.15   # fraction of gpu slices held for seq_len<=128
  token_budget_targets:
    default: 0.5
    long_seq: 0.2
```

chen: I can run a 5-node canary with that config. I'll also flip the kernel flag that disabled preempt and compare. Plan: run A/B over same traffic split for 30m, collect per-tenant p99, queue-length, kv_hit.

luca: Add a microtrace for slice-hold time and kernel-switch count. We need to see if preemptions are getting suppressed.

anya: Also correlate with model kv sizes — long sequences are more likely to thrash KV cache. If reserve helps, we should see kv_hit recover for short tenants.

vikram: OK assign: chen owns canary + dashboard. maria will synthload a short-heavy workload to validate. I'll review result and decide revert vs tune.

chen: Will run canary now and post results in ~45m. Patch: `pr/eng-runtime/5489` (contains config + metrics)

maria: Awesome — thanks. If this looks good we can bake short_slot_reserve into kernel-selection heuristics instead of a separate config.

luca: :thumbsup: keep an eye on cost impact (reserve reduces throughput). If we need, tune token_budget instead of absolute reserve to preserve utilization.

bench-bot: canary job started at 3345678912 by chen. Job id: canary-3345678912.

chen: posting interim numbers in thread when ready.

maria: TY — will follow up with perf dashboard link once load run completes.
